solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Help for travellers, broke, a shop arranged?

indicators.note: letters that are arranged are put into a new order, so the three words before it are shuffled

explanation.surface: A cash-strapped traveller wonders whether a shop can be set up to help them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' shuffles the ten letters of BROKE, A and SHOP together.
explanation.definitionFit: A small book of foreign-language expressions is a classic aid carried by tourists abroad.

clue.text: Drug supplier's growth area heard about — bequest not on?

definitions.note: the definition is the drug supplier, with 's standing for 'is'

indicators.note: what is heard is spoken, so the word for a growing area is rendered by its sound

parts.note: a farm is an area where crops are grown

indicators.note: not tells us to take the following word away from the bequest

parts.note: a legacy is something bequeathed in a will
in cricket the on side is also called the leg side, so on gives LEG

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a chemist's business: something about growing land and a legacy that has fallen through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heard about' makes the sound of FARM, spelt PHARM. 'not on' removes LEG from LEGACY, leaving ACY; in cricket the on side is the leg side.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist's shop dispenses medicines, so it is where prescriptions are supplied.

clue.text: Subjected to more questioning, slippery traitor reneged

indicators.note: something slippery will not stay in place, so the letters of the two following words slide into a new order

explanation.surface: A double-dealing traitor who went back on a promise is hauled in for further interrogation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slippery' shuffles the fourteen letters of TRAITOR and RENEGED.
explanation.definitionFit: Questioned again is the plain meaning: a suspect grilled a second time.

clue.text: Small brick carrier given footwear

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a hod is the open trough on a pole a builder's labourer uses to carry bricks

explanation.surface: A little hod-carrying labourer is handed a pair of work boots.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse or person fitted with shoes is said to be shod, the past participle of shoe.

clue.text: Brother about to take it easy in club wear?

indicators.note: about means the brother's letters go around the relaxing word

parts.note: to laze is to relax and do nothing

explanation.surface: A monk relaxes in whatever outfit his club requires.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that club wear is a definition by example: a blazer is the jacket of a sports club or school.
explanation.definitionFit: A blazer is a jacket, often striped or crested, worn by members of a club or team.

clue.text: Where in France you once used essentially smaller building

parts.note: ou is French for where
thou is the old form of you

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its core, so only the central letters of used are kept

explanation.surface: A question about a small building that French speakers once used.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' keeps the middle letters SE from USED.
explanation.definitionFit: A shed or privy standing apart from the main house is a lesser structure on the property.

clue.text: Part of Asia or of Ghana (to liar)

indicators.note: of here means made from part of, so the region is taken from within the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A geography question: is the place in Asia or in Ghana, put to a liar?
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' takes ANATOLIA from inside ghANA TO LIAr.
explanation.definitionFit: The Asian portion of Turkey, the peninsula also called Asia Minor, bears this name.

clue.text: Uncompromisingly conflicting Conservative or nice Liberal after conversion?

indicators.note: converted letters are changed into something new, so the pool is rearranged

explanation.surface: A Tory, or perhaps a pleasant Liberal who has switched sides, remains utterly opposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after conversion' shuffles C with the letters of OR NICE LIBERAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Positions that can never be reconciled clash with no hope of agreement.

clue.text: Move fast following drunk

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
lit is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: Someone tipsy hurries along behind another.
explanation.definitionFit: To dart or flutter lightly from place to place is to move swiftly.

clue.text: Song about Northern Australia rejected in this state

indicators.note: about means the song's letters go around the turned piece

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in an opera

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the letters for north and Australia are read backwards

parts.note: Oz is the informal name for Australia

explanation.surface: A song about northern Australia gets turned down in one particular state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns the northern and Australian letters into ZON; 'in this state' is the definition, with 'in' only joining.
explanation.definitionFit: The Grand Canyon State is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: East End riled as characters abandoned part of plant

indicators.note: letters are dropped from each end of the phrase, so the answer is what is left within it

explanation.surface: Cockneys get angry as actors walk out of a play.
explanation.walkthrough: With outer letters abandoned, TENDRIL sits inside easTENDRILed. 'East End' tempts you to think of Cockney dropped letters, but it is just fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing plant sends out thin coiling shoots that wrap round supports.

clue.text: Embattled on regular basis where there's no escape

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals means every second letter of the word is kept

explanation.surface: A beleaguered fighter stuck day after day in a place with no way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on regular basis' picks the even letters of eMbAtTlEd.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, checkmate is the position in which the king cannot escape capture.

clue.text: Bearing right to meet soldiers in warehouse

indicators.note: in places the right and the soldiers inside the warehouse

parts.note: a depot is a storehouse
men is a common crossword word for soldiers, the ranks

explanation.surface: Troops are stationed in a warehouse on the right-hand side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' looks like direction, a compass bearing; it is the definition in the sense of posture.
explanation.definitionFit: One's bearing is the way one carries oneself, i.e. posture and manner.

clue.text: Showing concern about call

parts.note: CA abbreviates circa, Latin for about
to ring someone is to telephone them

explanation.surface: A worried phone call about someone shows that you care.
explanation.definitionFit: Compassionate, kind behaviour displays concern for others.

clue.text: After container knocked over, message received — not entirely new element

indicators.note: something knocked over ends up upside down, which in a down clue reads the word backwards

parts.note: a tin is a container

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter of the radio word is dropped

parts.note: roger is the radio word meaning message received

explanation.surface: A tin gets knocked over just as a radio message is acknowledged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked over' turns TIN into NIT, 'not entirely' cuts ROGER to ROGE, then N.
explanation.definitionFit: The gas making up most of the air is chemical element number seven.

clue.text: Pale tree

definitions.meaning: a kind of willow, also called pussy willow

explanation.walkthrough: Two meanings: an adjective for a sickly complexion and a noun for a willow.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the spelling: a sickly yellowish face, and a low-growing willow.

clue.text: Plant producing type of shirt and jacket associated with 14

parts.note: a T-shirt is a type of shirt, giving the letter T
a reefer is a short double-breasted jacket
the chemical symbol of the element answering 14-down is N

explanation.surface: A shirt and jacket combination is linked to a gaseous element in a botanical outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference to 14 gives that answer's chemical symbol, N.
explanation.definitionFit: A large fern with a tall trunk-like stem is a plant found in tropical forests.

clue.text: Buyers of second-hand goods featured in newspaper piece

indicators.note: featured in places the buyers inside the newspaper

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times
rag-and-bone men, or ragmen, collect and buy old clothes and junk

explanation.surface: Junk dealers get a write-up in the paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piece' tempts as a newspaper article, which suits the surface, but it means a broken bit.
explanation.definitionFit: A small broken-off part of something is a bit or shard.

clue.text: Court probes means of access for cook?

indicators.note: probes means the court abbreviation goes into the doorway

parts.note: a door is how you get into a room

explanation.surface: A court investigates how a chef got in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' is a verb here, as in cooking the books; the question mark marks that unexpected sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To falsify accounts or tamper with evidence is to fiddle with them dishonestly.

clue.text: Starts to sample an unusual creation — exotic Russian dish

indicators.note: the starts of words are their first letters, taken from the six words that follow

explanation.surface: A diner tastes a strange new Russian dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starts to' takes the initials of sample an unusual creation exotic Russian.
explanation.definitionFit: The shallow plate under a cup is a small piece of crockery.

clue.text: Teacher employed in Michaelmas term

indicators.note: employed in means put to use within the phrase, so the answer lies inside its letters

explanation.surface: A schoolteacher is taken on for the autumn term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'employed in' finds the word inside michaelMAS TERm. Michaelmas term is the autumn term at British schools and universities.
explanation.definitionFit: A schoolmaster is a male teacher in British usage.

clue.text: Area religious leader and artist in call for aid programmes

indicators.note: in places the area, leader and artist inside the distress signal

parts.note: SOS is the distress signal
the Pope leads the Roman Catholic Church
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A distress call goes out involving a pontiff and a painter in some region.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-running TV or radio serial dramas are broadcast shows.

clue.text: Subdivision of clan — group seizing power

indicators.note: seizing means the group takes hold of the power letter inside it

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: A faction within a Scottish clan takes control.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scottish and Irish usage, a branch of a clan is a family division.

clue.text: Sell off as game over

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the game's name is read backwards

parts.note: golf is a game

explanation.surface: Once the game is done, it is time to sell up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns GOLF backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang to flog something is to sell it.

clue.text: Guide daughter at foot of green area

indicators.note: in a down clue, at the foot of means placed after, below the meadow

parts.note: a lea is a meadow

explanation.surface: A girl is shown the way at the bottom of a field.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide someone is to show them the way, to go in front.

clue.text: Go before decree altered after pressure

indicators.note: after means the reworked decree comes behind the pressure letter
altered means the letters of decree are changed in order

explanation.surface: An edict is amended once someone applies pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'altered' rearranges DECREE into RECEDE.
explanation.definitionFit: To come earlier in time or order than something is to precede it.

clue.text: Become anxious and start to moan in high-pitched voice

indicators.note: in places the first letter inside the singing voice

parts.note: treble is the highest singing voice, as of a boy

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A nervous person begins to whimper in a squeaky voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start to' takes M from MOAN and 'in' puts it within TREBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaking with fear or nerves is what an anxious person does.

clue.text: Part of recipe, popular, good, like some wine that's not lacking body?

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
red describes some wine
i.e., id est, means that is

indicators.note: a word lacking its body keeps only its ends, so the middle of not goes

explanation.surface: A popular, decent and full-bodied red wine is something a recipe calls for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is IE (that is), and 'lacking body' strips NOT to NT. 'not lacking body' reads as praise for the wine, but it is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Each item in a recipe's list is one component of the dish.
